Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D fighting-game sprite animation bank.
The attached image is the canonical IDENTITY AND STYLE REFERENCE, not an edit target. Create a NEW square 4-column by 4-row sprite sheet containing exactly SIXTEEN full-body poses of this SAME single character. Preserve the identical face, species, proportions, clothes, accessories, fur/skin patterns, colors, warm directional lighting, painterly shaded outlines and three-quarter camera facing RIGHT. This is one consistent character photographed at sixteen animation instants, not sixteen redesigns.
Output a genuinely transparent RGBA PNG. Every empty pixel surrounding characters must have alpha zero: no opaque black/white/gray field, no checkerboard baked into pixels. No grid lines, numbers, captions, text, labels, watermark, frames, props, floor shadows or environment. No sparks, impacts, speed streaks, auras or dust baked in; these are separate game effects.
Layout: exact invisible 4x4 equal-cell grid in row-major order. Keep EACH full silhouette safely inside its own cell, with generous clear transparent gutters of at least 12% around the cell edges. Standing poses occupy only 65–70% of cell height, never fill cells. Keep the same anatomical scale across all sixteen frames; do not enlarge crouched or fallen bodies to fill their cell. Keep an identical projected ground origin near the feet, with the standing baseline around86% down each cell; airborne poses rise above that baseline. Arms, ears, hands, tails and feet must remain completely visible and separated from neighboring poses. NO touching or crossing between cells. Never crop the canvas edge.
Anatomy: exactly two arms, two legs, two hands, two feet and the canonical number of ears and tails in every pose. Clear limb attachments, consistent species-specific hands/feet; no duplicate hands, fused limbs, missing feet, oversized human arm, or extra appendages. Preserve the character silhouette even in recoil or grounded poses.

XUNA identity lock: lean athletic anthropomorphic Mexican hairless xoloitzcuintle dog, smooth charcoal-gray skin with no fur, long slim canine muzzle, tall pointed ears with warm inner ears, narrow amber eyes, slender bare whip-like tail. Orange/copper sleeveless fitted lace-front vest, turquoise bead necklace and small turquoise wrist accents, white hand wraps, red waist sash with long hanging end, brown cropped trousers, bare charcoal canine feet. Never grow a fluffy tail, fur, mane, horns, new armor or weapon; retain the reference's lean proportions and understated calm expression.

Sixteen DIFFERENT movement frames, left-to-right then top-to-bottom:
Row1: (1) guard_shift: weight subtly shifts in ready boxing guard; (2) step_back: clear short backward step with guarded hands; (3) charge_crouch: knees bend and torso lowers to gather forward force; (4) heavy_windup: torso twists back, striking fist drawn far behind shoulder, planted feet.
Row2: (5) quick_windup: compact brief fist preparation near chest, small torso turn; (6) quick_extend: anatomically correct fully extended punch to the right, rear hand guarding; (7) follow_through: body weight continues forward AFTER the punch with shoulder rotation; (8) recovery: fist retracts halfway and torso returns toward balance.
Row3: (9) dash_lean: planted forward lean preparing a burst; (10) dash_stride: one strong forward running stride, body low; (11) jump_start: pushing off with both feet leaving the shared baseline, legs compress; (12) jump_apex: visibly airborne compact knees and guarded fist above the projected ground baseline.
Row4: (13) jump_strike: airborne rightward punch with natural compact legs; (14) jump_fall: descending from jump, knees and arms preparing landing; (15) landing: both feet planted with compressed knees, low stable body; (16) guard_settle: completed balanced defensive guard.
The silhouettes must tell a coherent anticipation→extension→follow-through→recovery and takeoff→airborne→landing story. Do not substitute generic idle poses for these distinct actions.
Final check: exactly16 separate complete full-body sprites, correct order, fixed identity and scale, clear transparent gutters, true alpha background.

Use case: background-extraction. Edit ONLY the attached sprite sheet background: remove the entire baked gray-and-white checkerboard and make those background pixels actually transparent alpha0. Deliver a genuine RGBA PNG with transparent background. Preserve the EXACT same sixteen character poses, same pixels' painted appearance, same dimensions, same4x4 arrangement, positions, anatomy, costume, colors, lighting, contours and scale. No new drawing, no reposing, no character redesign. Do not erase white/cream character details. No checkerboard should remain embedded in the resulting image. Keep all sixteen full silhouettes intact, including thin tails, ears and fingers. This is alpha extraction, not a new composition.
